Body.Content:
Microsoft now supports out-of-the-box integration with Genesys Cloud through the publicly available connectors and APIs exposed by Genesys. Customers can quickly connect Microsoft AI-powered voice and chat experiences to their existing Genesys environment without custom integration work. This streamlined approach reduces deployment complexity and enables organizations to be up and running in as little as 30 minutes, accelerating time-to-value while preserving existing contact center investments.

Genesys® and the Genesys logo are registered trademarks of Genesys Cloud Services, Inc., and/or its affiliates in the United States and certain other countries. No sponsorship or affiliation with Genesys is implied.

GA date: November CY2026

Preview date: October CY2026
